scenarios.title: Save changes to every editable task detail
given: The seeded task Finalize the product roadmap is visible and incomplete
when: The user changes the title, notes, category, priority, and due date
then: The same task displays all updated values

scenarios.title: Reject an empty edited title
given: An existing task is open for editing
when: The title is replaced with whitespace and save is attempted
then: Accessible validation feedback identifies the title problem
The original task remains unchanged in the list and storage

scenarios.title: Cancel discards unsaved changes
given: An existing task is open for editing
then: The original task values are displayed
Normal complete, edit, and delete actions are available

scenarios.title: Saved edits persist and update filtering
given: An existing task is visible in its current date and category view
when: The user edits searchable text, category, and due date and saves
The user reloads and navigates to the matching view or filter
then: The task appears only where its updated fields match
Task counts reflect the saved category and date

scenarios.title: Editing is accessible without breaking existing actions
when: The user locates edit controls by accessible task-specific names
The user uses labeled edit fields and save or cancel actions
The user adds, completes, searches for, and deletes tasks
then: Edit controls and fields have accessible names
Focus indicators and keyboard interaction remain available
No browser console errors occur throughout the run
